lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits. Each column contains 4 to 6 discrete local maxima with roughly uniform inter-blob spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern where the blobs serve as anchor nodes at the intersections of vertical and horizontal axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient indicating anatomical ridges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: At least four discrete high-luminance spots are visible within the perimeter of the first dorsal fin silhouette, displaying a lower spatial density compared to the pectoral fin.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high spatial density of significantly smaller high-luminance spots compared to the macro-patterning on the lateral flank.
